newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER - DALIAN WANDA SURGE AHEAD IN CHINA LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - DALIAN WANDA SURGE AHEAD IN CHINA LEAGUE.

text.p: Defending champions Dalian Wanda managed a 1-0 home victory over Yanbian Aodong in the second round of China's professional soccer league on Sunday and surged ahead in the table.
The defending champions extended their unbeaten streak to 36 games and topped the 12-team league with six points after two games this season.
The sole goal of the match came in the 23rd minute as forward Wang Tao converted a pass from Wei Yiming.
The match was mostly dominated by Dalian Wanda, and although Yanbian Aodong had some chances in the second half, they failed to convert.
It was the second straight defeat for Yanbian Aodong.
Last season's runners-up Shanghai Shenhua dropped to second place in the team standings after they were forced to a 1-1 draw by guests Sichuan Quanxin.
The Shanghai team, coached by a Bulgarian, led 1-0 after four minutes. But Sichuan Quanxin refused to give up and equalised after 25 minutes of fierce attacks.
Vanguard Huandao, who suffered a 0-2 loss to Dalian Wanda in the first round, played an inspired game against Tianjin Lifei.
The Vanguards conceded a goal due to an error by defenders and goal-keeper in the first half but fought back in the second half to level with a shot just outside the penalty area.
In other matches played on Sunday, Guangdong Hongyuan beat Beijing Guo'an 2-1, Jinan Taishan drew with Guangzhou Apollo 0-0 and August First drew with Qingdao Hainiu 1-1.
